name: Twin electric propulsion (600 V)
summary: Twin electric propulsion concept on a 600 V distribution bus, with one drive per shaft. The AC or DC architecture has not been selected, and the bus voltage is a design target rather than a validated architecture.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires electrical engineering, classification and high-voltage safety review before any design decision.
risks: High-voltage isolation, arc-flash and lockout procedures are not yet written.
Drive and motor thermal management is not sized.
Machinery location is not placed on the general arrangement.

name: Battery energy storage
summary: Battery energy storage for propulsion, hotel loads and the 90-day endurance target. Chemistry, capacity and location are not yet selected.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires electrical engineering, stability and fire-safety review before any design decision.
risks: The 90-day endurance target has no energy budget yet, so it is unverified.
Thermal runaway protection, fire detection and suppression, and ventilation are not designed.
Battery mass and location will affect the stability model.

name: Side thrusters (bow and stern)
summary: Bow and stern side thrusters for low-speed manoeuvring in harbour. Number, power, drive type and electrical supply are not yet selected.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires manoeuvring analysis, electrical engineering and classification review before any selection.

key_parameters.label: Electrical supply
key_parameters.value: Must match the selected bus, not decided

risks: Thruster power and drive type affect the electrical load and generator sizing.
Manoeuvring performance has not been analysed for the twin-propulsion configuration.
Tunnel and gearbox locations are not placed on the general arrangement.

name: Diesel generator sets (Kohler candidate)
summary: Diesel generator sets for ship's power and backup. Kohler is a candidate manufacturer. Model, rating and bus connection are not selected.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires electrical engineering, fuel-system and classification review before any selection.

key_parameters.label: Bus voltage match
key_parameters.value: Must match the selected bus (600 V or above 800 V, not decided)

key_parameters.label: Backup role
key_parameters.value: Ship's power and emergency backup, to be defined

risks: Generator voltage must match the bus architecture, which is not yet chosen.
Fuel supply, exhaust and ventilation routing are not placed on the general arrangement.
Backup power requirements for emergency loads are not yet defined.

name: Solar generation
summary: Photovoltaic generation on available exposed surfaces to offset hotel loads. Array area, output and mounting are not yet set.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires electrical engineering and structural review of mounting loads before any design decision.

key_parameters.label: Mounting surfaces
key_parameters.value: Candidate surfaces to be identified on the general arrangement

risks: Usable exposed area is limited by rig, tenders and deck arrangement.
Mounting loads have not been checked against the structure.

name: Backup and emergency power
summary: Emergency distribution for navigation, fire, communications and life-safety loads if the main bus fails. The load list and supply arrangement are not yet defined.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires classification and emergency-power review before any design decision.
risks: Emergency load list is not defined, so backup capacity cannot be sized.
Emergency switchboard location is not placed.

name: Electrical distribution
summary: Main switchboards, transformers, protection and distribution to hotel and technical loads. Bus voltage and layout depend on the propulsion decision.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires electrical engineering and classification review before any design decision.
risks: Bus voltage is unresolved, which blocks the switchboard and protection design.
Switchboard and cable routes are not placed on the general arrangement.

name: LED lighting
summary: Interior and exterior LED lighting for living spaces, circulation, navigation lights and deck work. Control zones and fixtures are not yet specified.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires electrical and navigation-light compliance review before any selection.

key_parameters.label: Navigation lights
key_parameters.value: Must meet applicable rules, not yet specified

risks: Navigation light arrangement must meet applicable rules and is not designed.
Power demand of lighting has not been added to the energy budget.

name: Water makers (desalination)
summary: Seawater desalination to supply potable water. Production rate, energy demand and intake and brine outlet positions are not yet set.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires marine engineering and potable-water compliance review.
risks: Potable water treatment and testing are not specified.
Intake and brine discharge locations need environmental review.

name: Fuel storage and processing
summary: Fuel tankage, transfer, settling, filtration and polishing for the diesel generators and propulsion. Tank capacity and layout are not yet set.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires fuel-system, fire-safety and classification review before any design decision.
risks: Fuel capacity is not sized against the endurance target.
Fuel tank protection, spill containment and fire boundaries are not designed.

name: Plumbing and freshwater distribution
summary: Freshwater, hot water and sanitary plumbing serving guest, crew and technical spaces. Routing and pressure system are not yet designed.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires marine plumbing and sanitation review before any design decision.

key_parameters.label: Routing
key_parameters.value: Not yet placed on the general arrangement

risks: Routing through tween and main-deck structure is not checked.
Pipe runs must keep clear of electrical and fuel routes.

name: Waste processing
summary: Onboard collection, separation and treatment of general waste, with blackwater and greywater handling addressed separately. Treatment method is not selected.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires environmental compliance review for each discharge and storage route.

key_parameters.label: Discharge rules
key_parameters.value: Depends on sea area; not yet mapped

risks: Storage capacity for a 90-day voyage is not calculated.
Discharge permissions differ by waters and are not yet mapped.

name: Waste compaction
summary: Compaction of dry waste and packaging to reduce storage volume between port calls. Equipment and location are not yet selected.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires hygiene and electrical review before any selection.
risks: Compactor power and location are not placed on the general arrangement.

name: Food waste processing
summary: Processing of food waste from galley and dining, to reduce storage and support compliant disposal. Method is not selected.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires food-safety and environmental review before any selection.
risks: Odour and hygiene control in the galley route is not designed.

name: Landfill management programme
summary: Policy for minimising waste sent to landfill over long voyages, covering provisioning, packaging, storage and shore disposal. Not yet written.
approval_status: Not written. Requires operational review once the programme is drafted.
risks: Provisioning and packaging policy has not been drafted.

name: HVAC
summary: Heating, ventilation and air conditioning for accommodation, bridge and machinery spaces. Plant, ducting and capacity are not yet sized.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires mechanical engineering review and an energy-budget check before any selection.
risks: HVAC load is not in the energy budget, so the battery sizing is incomplete.
Ducting routes through tween and main decks are not checked.

name: Food storage
summary: Dry, chilled and frozen storage sized for long passages and the 90-day provisioning requirement under study.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires food-safety and refrigeration review before any design decision.
risks: Provisioning volume depends on the 90-day target, which is not yet verified.
Cold-chain boundaries and fire separation are not fixed.

name: Tween deck accommodation
summary: Guest cabins, crew quarters, laundry and workshop on the tween deck, at a provisional +0.85 m datum.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires structural, fire and escape review before any design decision.
risks: Guest and crew circulation is not yet separated.
Escape routes and fire zoning are not designed.

name: Anchor system
summary: Bow anchoring with windlass, chain and anchor storage. Anchor mass, chain size and windlass power are not yet set.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires classification and mooring-load review before any selection.
risks: Anchor and chain sizing depends on the hull model, which is not validated.
Windlass load path into the forward structure is not designed.

name: Sail systems
summary: Ketch rig with mainmast and mizzen, sail handling and reefing. Sail loads, reefing geometry and rig performance are not approved.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires rig, structural and class review before any design decision.
risks: Sail loads and reefing geometry are not approved.
Mast foundation loads are not reconciled with the structure.

name: Kitchen accommodation
summary: Professional galley and bar fit-out, including preparation, cooking, washing and service routes.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires food-safety and fire review before any fit-out decision.
risks: Cold-chain and fire boundaries are not fixed.
Service routes to guest areas are not checked.

name: Bathroom accommodation
summary: En-suite bathrooms for owner, guest and crew cabins, with sanitary and ventilation routes.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires marine sanitation and ventilation review before any design decision.
risks: Sanitary and waste routes must keep clear of electrical spaces.

name: Curated art
summary: Curated art programme for shared spaces and cabins, with mounting and environmental control. Works and locations are not yet selected.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires conservation and mounting review before any installation.

key_parameters.label: Environmental control
key_parameters.value: Humidity and light levels to be set

risks: Motion loads and humidity affect works and mounting; not yet specified.

name: Glassware storage
summary: Secured racks and cabinets for glassware and fine tableware, designed to resist motion at sea.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires motion-securing review before any installation.
risks: Racks must hold under the design motions, which have not been specified.

name: Navigation systems
summary: Navigation suite at the bridge and the outdoor pilot house: radar, charting, AIS, autopilot and instruments. Equipment is not selected.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires navigation-equipment and classification review before any selection.
risks: Navigation remains safety-critical; equipment and redundancy are not chosen.
Power supply for navigation is not linked to the emergency power design.

name: External communications
summary: Satellite and radio communications for distress, weather, shore and crew contact. Equipment and antenna positions are not chosen.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires radio licensing and GMDSS review before any selection.
risks: Distress communications must meet licensing rules and are not yet specified.
Antenna positions are not checked for interference with the rig.

name: Ship communications (internal)
summary: Internal ship communications: intercom, crew paging and alarm notification across the five levels.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires alarm and emergency-notification review before any selection.
risks: Emergency notification must reach every level and is not yet designed.

name: Command and control
summary: Integrated control of propulsion, power, alarms and systems status from the bridge, with local control at machinery.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires control-system and classification review before any design decision.
risks: Control redundancy is not defined, so failure modes are not analysed.
Software and cybersecurity requirements are not written.

name: Audio-visual and media systems
summary: Audio, video and media distribution across salons, cabins and the lido, with central control.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires electrical and acoustic review before any selection.
risks: Equipment racks and cable routes are not placed.

name: Wifi and onboard network
summary: Onboard wireless and wired network for guests, crew and systems, separated by security zone. Design is not started.
approval_status: Not designed. Requires network security review before any deployment.

key_parameters.label: Network zones
key_parameters.value: Guest, crew and systems (to be defined)

risks: Systems and guest networks must be separated; not yet designed.
Network details are withheld from public release.

name: Premise security
summary: Physical security for the vessel, including perimeter, cameras, alarms and protected areas. Layout is not designed.
approval_status: Not designed. Requires security-consultant review. Details are withheld from public release.
risks: Security layout is not designed and is withheld from public release.

name: Keycard access control
summary: Keycard access to cabins, technical spaces and restricted areas, with logging. Technology and zones are not selected.
approval_status: Not designed. Requires security and life-safety review, including egress, before any selection. Withheld from public release.
risks: Access must never block emergency egress; the failure mode is not designed.
Specifications are withheld from public release.

name: Policies and procedures
summary: Written operating policies and procedures for safety, environmental management, guests and crew. None has been drafted yet.
approval_status: Not drafted. Requires flag-state and class review once written.

key_parameters.label: Document control
key_parameters.value: Revision history to be set up

risks: No policies exist yet, so operational assumptions are not recorded.

name: Checklist and procedure system
summary: Structured checklists for operations and maintenance, linked to each system. Draft checklists are stored in checklists.json and are not approved for use.
approval_status: Draft only. Each checklist requires an approved procedure before use on a vessel.

key_parameters.label: Checklists drafted
key_parameters.value: See the checklists on each system

risks: Draft checklists must not be used for operations until approved.

name: Onboard automation
summary: Automation of routine ship functions such as monitoring, alarms and scheduled tasks. Scope and control authority are not yet defined.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires control-system and classification review. Automation must not override manual control.
risks: Automation scope is undefined, so failure behaviour cannot be analysed.

name: Guest services
summary: Guest request handling, concierge and housekeeping. Proposed for a separate guest application; not yet confirmed as in scope for this repository.
approval_status: Not designed. Scope decision pending.
risks: Guest data is personal data and needs a backend, which this static app does not have.

name: Dining service
summary: Dining service across the Main salon, Aft Lido and bar. Proposed for a separate guest application; not yet confirmed as in scope.
approval_status: Not designed. Scope decision pending.
risks: Service routes between galley and venues are not yet checked.

name: Booking and reservations
summary: Reservations for dining and experiences. Proposed for a separate guest application because it needs accounts, payments and personal data.
approval_status: Not designed. Scope decision pending. Payments and personal data need a separate review.

key_parameters.label: Payments
key_parameters.value: Not in scope for this repository

risks: Personal and payment data are outside what a static app can hold securely.

name: Dinner for two in the bay
summary: A private dinner for two served in the bay. Proposed experience only; service location, tender and safety arrangements are not designed.
approval_status: Not designed. Requires operational and safety review of tender and bay use.
risks: Bay service needs safe access and weather limits, not yet defined.
Booking depends on the separate guest application.

name: Guest apps and guest experience
summary: Guest-facing app for information, requests and bookings. Proposed for a separate project; not part of this repository.
approval_status: Not designed. Scope decision pending.

key_parameters.label: Connection to onboard network
key_parameters.value: Via separate guest network (to be defined)

risks: App depends on backend services and the onboard network, neither of which exists yet.

name: Engineering components (general)
summary: Shared engineering components across the vessel: machinery seating, pumps, valves, and serviceability clearances. Equipment list is not yet compiled.
approval_status: Not reviewed. Requires marine engineering and classification review before any selection.
risks: Machinery space and service clearances are not placed on the layout.
Shared components have not been traced to systems.

name: Hospitality systems (general)
summary: Shared hospitality infrastructure linking guest services, dining, booking and guest apps. Proposed for a separate guest application; scope not yet confirmed.
approval_status: Not designed. Scope decision pending.
risks: Guest data needs a backend, which this static app does not have.
